MAKER

Freshman at UF. I take parts made for one job and make them do another. Humidifier parts became a pocket nebulizer. Smart glasses became a way for deaf people to see sound. Shape-memory metal became the motor for a satellite drag sail.

Featured build · version 3

zer0mask

I’ve had asthma my whole life, and regular nebulizers are bulky, loud, and expensive. So I built one the size of an inhaler, from off-the-shelf humidifier parts, a recycled vape battery, and a fully 3D printed body.

in parts, vs. $60+ for a typical nebulizer
